content: CONFIRMED, `SessionDocument.usageData()` boxes counters as `Long`, while `JacksonSessionCodec.objectMap()` decodes small JSON integers as `Integer`; `Map.equals` therefore makes otherwise identical persisted documents unequal. Fix at the canonical JSON-value boundary, `/E:/Projects/Code/AI/Ji/ji-java/core/ji-session-api/src/main/java/io/github/diodeme/ji/session/tree/SessionDocument.java:1723`, by recursively normalizing integral values to one representation; changing only SQLite or enabling Jackson `USE_LONG_FOR_INTS` would merely move the mismatch to existing `Integer` literals such as `attempt=1`.
